citations.claim: body centre reached the wall face with deep overlap exceeding limit at first violating step
one step earlier body was 1.5 units away, so it jumped ~2 units in one step onto/into thin wall
initial position far from wall showing high-speed approach

explanation: Fast body (vx=60, ~2 units/step) hits thin wall (w=0.1). Between step 3 (x~8, 1.5 from wall) and step 4 (x~10) the centre lands exactly on the wall's left face, ending with 0.5 overlap (r=0.5 fully embedded against face). Impulse plus positional correction failed to prevent/resolve deep penetration in a single step despite 68 substeps, indicating missing continuous collision handling for thin walls at high speed.
vision_note: The red circle moves rightward toward the thin vertical wall across steps 1-3. In step 4 it ends up centered directly on the wall line, visibly embedded in it instead of bouncing off.
